# NEI special-data v1 fixture

This immutable, network-independent sidecar is a compact compatibility fixture for the maintained special-data
export overlay. It contains one representative record for every requested NEI category, including two- and
four-parent crop breeding, a reagent-gated meteor ritual, grouped and limited loot, a conditional vending trade,
world-generation loot, and branched chemical-bath/sifter ore processing.

The stable goods IDs are fixture IDs only; the fixture does not claim ownership of the referenced mod content and
does not include the private NESQL database or generated sprites. Add a sibling fixture for a changed source shape;
never replace this file in place.
